items.title: El Salvador receives $138 million from IMF after Bitcoin waivers granted
items.snippet: Efforts will continue to reduce the state’s involvement in Bitcoin-related activities and to strengthen crypto‑asset regulation and governance, the IMF said.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Russia’s Finance Ministry pays wages in digital rubles for first time
items.snippet: Work on the introduction of the digital ruble to the budget process is being carried out by the Bank of Russia together with the Ministry of Finance.
items.note: Негативний тон для ETH за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
